personas.name: Maya, 28
personas.character_sheet: Urban renter, browses on phone during commutes and lunch breaks. Spends $40-120 per impulse purchase when the image catches her eye. Trust triggers: clean modern photography, real-people reviews, clear shipping time. Skepticism: low on ad itself, medium once she hits price. Bounces if pages feel crowded or slow. Wants: fast gratification, visible stock, one-click checkout.
